normalWorkflow: drop an unextracted Havenwild_IncrementalPatch_*.zip into the repository root
choose Build & Verify -> Full quality gate
the full quality gate invokes root patch intake before root cleanliness validation
patch intake transactionally backs up and applies controlled overwrite/removal data
payload hashes and post-apply state are verified
successful patch transport is archived outside the repository root
root cleanliness audit runs only after consumed patch transports have left the root
the full quality gate continues into build, tests, validation, and debug bundle handling
rootPolicy: Consumed patch ZIPs are archived before the normal root cleanliness assertion. Patch transport never becomes repository-root source authority.
